integrity: Every finite enumeration and acyclic matching is specified by a standalone standard-library program, with a complete proof linking its exact finite certificates to the asserted homotopy and rational group representation. The homotopy classification is a finite theorem, not a numerically inferred infinite-family claim.
scientific_limitations: The calculation applies to the eight-vertex cube Q_3 with matching threshold three, and does not imply a formula for larger crown graphs or hypercubes. The symmetry decomposition is over the rationals; no integral equivariant classification is asserted. Related published sources and mathematical equivalences were examined, but unidentified equivalent work remains possible.
title: Nine three-spheres and signed cube symmetry in a non-matching complex
